name: La Cadena Rota: Supply Chain Basics
description: Three-round introductory simulation teaching supply chain fundamentals through ProteínaCo S.A.S., a Colombian protein supplement manufacturer. Students manage demand forecasting, inventory decisions, supplier selection, and logistics trade-offs while experiencing the Bullwhip Effect, EOQ principles, and Total Cost of Ownership in an Andean manufacturing context.

js: (function() { 'use strict'; class CadenaRotaAdapter extends USF.SimulationAdapter { constructor() { super(); this.name = 'La Cadena Rota: Supply Chain Basics'; this.version = '1.1.0'; this.SUPPLIERS = { barato: { name: 'Proveedor Barato S.A.', price: 18200, leadTime: 5, defectRate: 0.12, minOrder: 500, inspectionCost: 450, reworkCost: 4200 }, agroprot: { name: 'AgroProt Colombia', price: 22400, leadTime: 3, defectRate: 0.021, minOrder: 300, inspectionCost: 280, reworkCost: 4200 }, agriprotein: { name: 'AgriProteín Andina', price: 26600, leadTime: 8, defectRate: 0.009, minOrder: 800, inspectionCost: 150, reworkCost: 4200 } }; this.ROUTES = { A: { name: 'Route A — Own fleet', cost: 1200, days: 1, reliability: 0.98 }, B: { name: 'Route B — Shared logistics', cost: 650, days: 2, reliability: 0.88 }, C: { name: 'Route C — Courier', cost: 950, days: 1, reliability: 0.72 } }; this.PHASES = ['Aprende el Sistema', 'La Ola de Demanda', 'Regulación y Adaptación']; this.DEMAND_BASE = [7000, 7000, 7000]; this.DEMAND_SHOCK = [7000, 9660, 7000]; } initialize(state) { if (!state.domainState || Object.keys(state.domainState).length === 0) { state.domainState = { cash: 4800000000, inventoryFG: 2000, inventoryRM: 1500, totalSales: 0, totalCosts: 0, otifHistory: [], costHistory: [], inventoryHistory: [], defectsHistory: [], stockoutHistory: [], supplierChoices: [], routeChoices: [], eventsTriggered: [] }; } if (!state.decisions || Object.keys(state.decisions).length === 0) { state.decisions = { forecast: 7000, supplier: 'agroprot', orderQty: 800, production: 7000, safetyStock: 500, route: 'A' }; } this._updateTCO(state); this._setupEventListeners(); } validateDecisions(decisions) { const forecastInput = document.getElementById('forecastInput'); const supplierSelect = document.getElementById('supplierSelect'); const orderQtyInput = document.getElementById('orderQtyInput'); const productionInput = document.getElementById('productionInput'); const safetyStockSelect = document.getElementById('safetyStockSelect'); const routeSelect = document.getElementById('routeSelect'); if (forecastInput) decisions.forecast = parseInt(forecastInput.value); if (supplierSelect) decisions.supplier = supplierSelect.value; if (orderQtyInput) decisions.orderQty = parseInt(orderQtyInput.value); if (productionInput) decisions.production = parseInt(productionInput.value); if (safetyStockSelect) decisions.safetyStock = parseInt(safetyStockSelect.value); if (routeSelect) decisions.route = routeSelect.value; const sup = this.SUPPLIERS[decisions.supplier]; if (decisions.orderQty < sup.minOrder) { window.mySimulation.uiManager.showNotification(window.mySimulation.t('min_order_warning').replace('{min}', sup.minOrder), 'warning'); return false; } if (decisions.production < 3000) { window.mySimulation.uiManager.showNotification(window.mySimulation.t('min_production_warning'), 'warning'); return false; } return true; } calculateResults(state) { const d = state.decisions; const period = state.currentPeriod; const sup = this.SUPPLIERS[d.supplier]; const route = this.ROUTES[d.route]; let actualDemand = this.DEMAND_BASE[period - 1]; if (period === 2) { actualDemand = this.DEMAND_SHOCK[period - 1]; } const forecastError = Math.abs(d.forecast - actualDemand) / actualDemand; const rawMaterialNeeded = d.production * 0.285; const orderDefects = Math.round(d.orderQty * sup.defectRate); const usableRM = d.orderQty - orderDefects; const rmShortage = Math.max(0, rawMaterialNeeded - state.domainState.inventoryRM - usableRM); const maxProduction = Math.min(d.production, (state.domainState.inventoryRM + usableRM) / 0.285); const overtimeUnits = Math.max(0, maxProduction - 8000); const undertimeUnits = Math.max(0, 6000 - maxProduction); const unitsProduced = Math.floor(maxProduction); const availableFG = state.domainState.inventoryFG + unitsProduced; const unitsSold = Math.min(actualDemand, availableFG); const stockouts = actualDemand - unitsSold; const emergencyOrders = stockouts > 0 ? Math.ceil(stockouts / 1000) : 0; const deliveryDelay = Math.random() > route.reliability ? 1 : 0; const otif = unitsSold >= actualDemand * 0.95 && deliveryDelay === 0 ? 100 : Math.round((unitsSold / actualDemand) * 100 * (1 - deliveryDelay * 0.15)); const rmCost = d.orderQty * sup.price; const inspectionCost = d.orderQty * sup.inspectionCost; const reworkCost = orderDefects * sup.reworkCost; const emergencyCost = rmShortage > 0 ? rmShortage * sup.price * 1.5 : 0; const productionCost = unitsProduced * 47000 + overtimeUnits * 2100 + undertimeUnits * 1500; const holdingCost = (state.domainState.inventoryFG + unitsProduced - unitsSold / 2) * 2500; const safetyCost = d.safetyStock * 2500; const logisticsCost = Math.ceil(unitsSold / 100) * route.cost + emergencyOrders * 50000; const stockoutCost = stockouts * 15000; const totalCost = rmCost + inspectionCost + reworkCost + emergencyCost + productionCost + holdingCost + safetyCost + logisticsCost + stockoutCost; const revenue = unitsSold * 68000; const profit = revenue - totalCost; state.domainState.inventoryRM = Math.max(0, state.domainState.inventoryRM + usableRM - rawMaterialNeeded); state.domainState.inventoryFG = availableFG - unitsSold + d.safetyStock; state.domainState.cash += profit; state.domainState.totalSales += unitsSold; state.domainState.totalCosts += totalCost; state.domainState.otifHistory.push(otif); state.domainState.costHistory.push(totalCost); state.domainState.inventoryHistory.push(state.domainState.inventoryFG); state.domainState.defectsHistory.push(orderDefects); state.domainState.stockoutHistory.push(stockouts); state.domainState.supplierChoices.push(d.supplier); state.domainState.routeChoices.push(d.route); const results = { period, forecast: d.forecast, actualDemand, unitsSold, stockouts, orderDefects, otif, totalCost, unitCost: Math.round(totalCost / Math.max(1, unitsSold)), revenue, profit, cash: state.domainState.cash, inventoryFG: state.domainState.inventoryFG, inventoryRM: state.domainState.inventoryRM, supplier: sup.name, route: route.name }; this._showResults(results); this._triggerRandomEvent(state, period); return results; } setupUI(uiManager) { uiManager.bind('currentDay', 'currentPeriod'); uiManager.bind('maxPeriods', 'maxPeriods'); uiManager.bind('otifDisplay', 'results.otif', (v) => v + '%'); uiManager.bind('inventoryDisplay', 'domainState.inventoryFG', (v) => v.toLocaleString() + ' units'); uiManager.bind('cashDisplay', 'domainState.cash', (v) => 'COP $' + (v / 1000000).toFixed(1) + 'M'); uiManager.bind('unitCostDisplay', 'results.unitCost', (v) => 'COP $' + v.toLocaleString()); uiManager.bind('productionValue', 'decisions.production'); } _updateTCO(state) { const d = state.decisions || { supplier: 'agroprot', orderQty: 800 }; const sup = this.SUPPLIERS[d.supplier]; const orderQty = d.orderQty || 800; const purchase = orderQty * sup.price; const inspection = orderQty * sup.inspectionCost; const expectedDefects = Math.round(orderQty * sup.defectRate); const rework = expectedDefects * sup.reworkCost; const total = purchase + inspection + rework; const tcoPurchase = document.getElementById('tcoPurchase'); const tcoInspection = document.getElementById('tcoInspection'); const tcoRework = document.getElementById('tcoRework'); const tcoTotal = document.getElementById('tcoTotal'); if (tcoPurchase) tcoPurchase.textContent = 'COP $' + purchase.toLocaleString(); if (tcoInspection) tcoInspection.textContent = 'COP $' + inspection.toLocaleString(); if (tcoRework) tcoRework.textContent = 'COP $' + rework.toLocaleString(); if (tcoTotal) tcoTotal.textContent = 'COP $' + total.toLocaleString(); } _setupEventListeners() { const self = this; const supplierSelect = document.getElementById('supplierSelect'); const orderQtyInput = document.getElementById('orderQtyInput'); if (supplierSelect) { supplierSelect.addEventListener('change', function() { self._updateTCO(window.mySimulation.state); }); } if (orderQtyInput) { orderQtyInput.addEventListener('input', function() { self._updateTCO(window.mySimulation.state); }); } const productionInput = document.getElementById('productionInput'); const productionValue = document.getElementById('productionValue'); if (productionInput && productionValue) { productionInput.addEventListener('input', function() { productionValue.textContent = parseInt(this.value).toLocaleString(); }); } } _showResults(results) { const panel = document.getElementById('resultsPanel'); const resDemand = document.getElementById('resDemand'); const resSold = document.getElementById('resSold'); const resStockouts = document.getElementById('resStockouts'); const resDefects = document.getElementById('resDefects'); const resOtif = document.getElementById('resOtif'); const resCost = document.getElementById('resCost'); if (resDemand) resDemand.textContent = results.actualDemand.toLocaleString(); if (resSold) resSold.textContent = results.unitsSold.toLocaleString(); if (resStockouts) resStockouts.textContent = results.stockouts.toLocaleString(); if (resDefects) resDefects.textContent = results.orderDefects.toLocaleString(); if (resOtif) resOtif.textContent = results.otif + '%'; if (resCost) resCost.textContent = 'COP $' + (results.totalCost / 1000000).toFixed(2) + 'M'; if (panel) panel.style.display = 'block'; } _triggerRandomEvent(state, period) { const rand = Math.random(); let event = null; if (period === 1 && state.decisions.supplier === 'barato' && rand < 0.3) { event = { title: 'Lote Defectuoso', desc: 'A batch from Proveedor Barato arrives with 24% defect rate — double their average. Quality control flagged the issue.', choices: ['Reject and re-order emergency (1.4× cost)', 'Accept and rework (+COP $4,200/unit)', 'Accept full lot (risk customer complaints)'] }; } else if (rand < 0.15) { event = { title: 'Huelga de Transportistas', desc: '3-day trucking strike affects Bogotá logistics. Route B deliveries halted completely.', choices: ['Switch to air freight (8× cost)', 'Negotiate partial service agreements', 'Use light vehicles (40% capacity only)'] }; } else if (period >= 2) { event = { title: 'Oportunidad: Farmatodo', desc: 'National pharmacy chain offers 2,500 units/month contract with 48-hour delivery requirement and private label packaging (+COP $3,200/unit).', choices: ['Accept full contract (requires +2,500 units capacity)', 'Negotiate pilot (500 units, 60 stores)', 'Decline — focus on current customers'] }; } if (event) { const panel = document.getElementById('eventPanel'); const title = document.getElementById('eventTitle'); const desc = document.getElementById('eventDesc'); const choices = document.getElementById('eventChoices'); if (panel && title && desc && choices) { title.textContent = event.title; desc.textContent = event.desc; choices.innerHTML = ''; event.choices.forEach((c, i) => { const btn = document.createElement('button'); btn.className = 'cadenarota-event-btn'; btn.textContent = c; btn.onclick = function() { panel.style.display = 'none'; }; choices.appendChild(btn); }); panel.style.display = 'block'; state.domainState.eventsTriggered.push(event.title); } } } getChartConfig() { return { inventoryChart: { type: 'line', data: { labels: ['Start', 'M1', 'M2', 'M3'], datasets: [{ label: this._t('chart_inv_fg'), data: [2000, 0, 0, 0], borderColor: '#3b82f6', backgroundColor: 'rgba(59,130,246,0.1)', borderWidth: 3, fill: true, tension: 0.3 }, { label: this._t('chart_inv_safety'), data: [0, 0, 0, 0], borderColor: '#f59e0b', borderWidth: 2, borderDash: [5, 5], pointRadius: 0 }] }, options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { title: { display: true, text: this._t('chart_inv_title'), color: '#334155' }, legend: { position: 'bottom' } }, scales: { y: { beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: '#e2e8f0' }, ticks: { color: '#64748b' } }, x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: '#64748b' } } } } }, performanceChart: { type: 'bar', data: { labels: ['Month 1', 'Month 2', 'Month 3'], datasets: [{ label: this._t('chart_perf_otif'), data: [0, 0, 0], backgroundColor: '#10b981', borderColor: '#047857', borderWidth: 1 }, { label: this._t('chart_perf_cost'), data: [0, 0, 0], backgroundColor: '#3b82f6', borderColor: '#1e40af', borderWidth: 1 }] }, options: { responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, plugins: { title: { display: true, text: this._t('chart_perf_title'), color: '#334155' }, legend: { position: 'bottom' } }, scales: { y: { beginAtZero: true, grid: { color: '#e2e8f0' }, ticks: { color: '#64748b' } }, x: { grid: { display: false }, ticks: { color: '#64748b' } } } } } }; } getChartData(state) { const labels = state.domainState.inventoryHistory.map((_, i) => 'M' + (i + 1)); labels.unshift('Start'); const fgData = [2000, ...state.domainState.inventoryHistory]; const safetyData = state.domainState.inventoryHistory.map((_, i) => { const decisions = state.history[i]?.decisions; return decisions ? decisions.safetyStock : 500; }); safetyData.unshift(0); const otifData = state.domainState.otifHistory.length ? state.domainState.otifHistory : [0, 0, 0]; const costData = state.domainState.costHistory.map(c => Math.round(c / 1000 / Math.max(1, state.domainState.totalSales / Math.max(1, state.currentPeriod)))); return { inventoryChart: { labels: labels, datasets: [{ data: fgData }, { data: safetyData }] }, performanceChart: { labels: state.domainState.otifHistory.map((_, i) => this._t('month_short') + ' ' + (i + 1)), datasets: [{ data: otifData }, { data: costData }] } }; } getPerformanceSummary(history) { if (!history.length) return {}; const otifScores = history.map(r => r.results?.otif || 0); const avgOtif = otifScores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / otifScores.length;
